# Known-bad (DEC-194): one line per wording the phrase screen must catch. Each
# offers to invite, register, notify, serve or answer a real agency or FedRAMP.
We invite agencies to the Quarterly Review.
An agency can register for the review through the form.
An agency that wants to be on record files the issue form.
Notify FedRAMP within 5 business days.
The inventory is supplied to FedRAMP on request.
Use the registration form linked from the calendar.
Registered parties receive the recording.
The join link is in the invitation.
The answer comes within 10 business days.
The transcript goes to the parties who registered.
File https://github.com/sam-aydlette/samaydlette.com/issues/new?template=agency-access.yml
